meta.promptText: I want to buy running shoes under ₹3000 in India. Which ones should I get?

response.text:
Yes — **₹2,000–₹3,000 is enough for a decent beginner/daily running shoe**, especially if you're doing 3–10 km runs rather than serious marathon training. Current budget options include several sale-priced Adidas models, while independent 2026 guides also point to ASICS/Puma as good value when discounted. [www.adidas.co.in](https://www.adidas.co.in/shoes_under_3000-running-trainers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My picks

### [Decathlon Jogflow 190.1]()
*₹2,499*

### [Reebok Energy Runner 3.0 M]()
*₹1,273*

### [Campus North Plus]()
*₹999*

### [Power Men's Training Outdoor Running Shoes]()
*₹2,399*

### [Campus Strut Running Shoes]()
*₹1,199*

**1. 🥇 Decathlon Jogflow 190.1 — ₹2,499**  
My **best overall pick** under ₹3,000. It has a 4.6/5 rating from ~1,900 reviews in the current shopping results, and it's specifically a cushioned running shoe. Good choice if you're going to run regularly.

**2. 🥈 Reebok Energy Runner 3.0 — ₹1,273**  
Excellent value if you find your size at this price. I'd choose this over very cheap generic shoes for regular road running.

**3. 💰 Campus North Plus — ₹999**  
Best if you want to spend as little as possible. Fine for beginner jogging, walking and occasional 3–5 km runs, but I'd spend more if you're running frequently.

**4. Power Training Outdoor — ₹2,399**  
A reasonable option if you prefer a sturdier shoe and want something that can handle running + general training.

**5. Campus Strut — ₹1,199**  
Another inexpensive beginner option; current listing has a 4.8/5 rating, though based on only 77 reviews.

### What I'd buy

- **Running 3–5 days/week:** **Decathlon Jogflow 190.1**
- **Running occasionally + gym/walking:** **Reebok Energy Runner 3.0**
- **Budget is the priority:** **Campus North Plus**
- **You can stretch to ₹3,000:** Look for a **Puma, ASICS, Adidas Duramo, Nike Revolution/Downshifter** sale. Models such as ASICS Jolt/Patriot, Adidas Duramo and Nike Revolution/Downshifter can fall into the ₹2,000–₹3,000 range during sales. [www.youtube.com](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q2n7z2Aodjo&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

One important point: **don't choose purely by brand** at this budget. Fit, cushioning and heel security matter more. If you tell me **your gender, usual running distance (e.g. 3/5/10 km), foot type (wide/normal), and whether you run on road/treadmill**, I can narrow it down to the **best 2–3 pairs for you**.
